matching_policy.public_negative_rule: Exclude clip-stage if any allowed target phones occur contiguously in full reference phones
matching_policy.limitation: Existing child-oriented matrix applied identically; diagnostic context acceptance, no VAD or production confirmation/rearm state

limitations: Transcript G2P reference, not expert heard-phone annotation
CV ages self-reported; owned two music speaker ages unconfirmed; Zeroth per-speaker ages absent
Zeroth domain overlaps original model training/evaluation corpus; upstream overlap for other checkpoints unknown
All checkpoints before our child fine-tuning; future child learning effect unmeasured
Public-speech negatives and generated non-speech are diagnostics, not field FAR
Playback changes pitch and tempo simultaneously

commonvoice.dataset: Mozilla Common Voice 17 Korean; public fsicoli mirror
commonvoice.selection: test split, self-reported twenties/thirties/fourties; all 208 clips

zeroth.attribution: Zeroth Project / goodatlas, https://openslr.org/40/ and https://github.com/goodatlas/zeroth, CC BY 4.0; mirror kresnik/zeroth_korean

normalization.same_for_all: Transcript G2P for references and original text, direct MFA/jamo-to-IPA for phone models; ae/e merged, l+tap -> l+l; no target-dependent alias or repeated-vowel collapse
normalization.reference_warning: G2P of written transcripts is not actual heard-phone ground truth

verdict.reason: Improves all 21 CV adult speakers and short-word phonetic retention, while clean Zeroth accuracy regresses and continuous-speech false acceptance persists
verdict.foreign_candidate_priority: lower given measured starting checkpoint; future fine-tuning effect not measured
